name: WdRelativeHorizontalSize
description: Specifies the relative width of a shape using the value specified in the WidthRelative property for a Shape or ShapeRange object.

constants.name: wdRelativeHorizontalSizeMargin
constants.description: Width is relative to the space between the left margin and the right margin.

constants.name: wdRelativeHorizontalSizePage
constants.description: Width is relative to the width of the page.

constants.name: wdRelativeHorizontalSizeLeftMarginArea
constants.description: Width is relative to the size of the left margin.

constants.name: wdRelativeHorizontalSizeRightMarginArea
constants.description: Width is relative to the width of the right margin.

constants.name: wdRelativeHorizontalSizeInnerMarginArea
constants.description: Width is relative to the size of the inside margin; to the size of the left margin for odd pages, and to the size of the right margin for even pages.

constants.name: wdRelativeHorizontalSizeOuterMarginArea
constants.description: Width is relative to the size of the outside margin; to the size of the right margin for odd pages, and to the size of the left margin for even pages.
